test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Out of the four words listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
 

 First Class (FC)
 Train Class
 
 

 AC 3 Tier (3A)
 Train Class
 
 

 AC 2 Tier (2A)
 Train Class
 
 

 **Ticket**
 **Not a Train Class**
 
 

 

First Class (FC), AC 3 Tier (3A), and AC 2 Tier (2A) all are Train Classes,

Whereas,

Ticket is not a Train Class.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Ticket"**.
